name: Is This a Pigeon
look: An anime still of a young man with dark hair and glasses, in a white jacket with a red collar, holding a book and gesturing with an open palm toward a yellow butterfly fluttering beside a window.
use: The man, the butterfly and the question are all labeled: someone confidently misidentifies one thing as something else entirely, with the bottom caption asking Is this a...?
slots: the wrong guess, Is this a...? (bottom)

anime man gesturing at a yellow butterfly by a window
guy with glasses confidently misidentifying something
japanese cartoon character with a book and a butterfly
origin: A still from the 1991 anime series The Brave of Sun Fighbird.
